source_level_regression.scope: jsdom lifecycle test, parser and reconciliation workers mocked; native dialog open/close stubs, no browser worker proof
source_level_regression.reproduced_defect: Cancelled supplemental parsing could finish later and call calculate(), which aborted the newer current worker before checking its stale operation token.
source_level_regression.before: Regression failed: newer AbortSignal.aborted was true, expected false.
source_level_regression.fix: Check operation token before calculate() touches abortRef, and immediately after awaited supplemental parsing.
source_level_regression.after: Targeted 10/10 and full 330/330 tests passed; typecheck, build, artifact scan and format check passed.
source_level_regression.typecheck_initial_harness_failure: A generic type mismatch in the new test helper was corrected before final successful typecheck.
